text.p: Fountain Oil Inc said on Thursday it completed the issuance of 1,139,800 common shares on Wednesday upon the exercise of stock purchase warrants expiring February 28, 1997, at an exercise price of $5.10 per share.
The company said it received proceeds of $5,812,980.

It noted the warrants had been called for redemption, adding all outstanding warrants of that series have been exercised. After this exercise, Fountain Oil has a total of 18,828,410 shares outstanding.

The proceeds will be used to pay for capital expenditures and operating costs until positive cash flow is obtained on oil and gas fields in which Fountain Oil has an ownership interest, the company said.
